title: Grateful Dead Live at The Silver Dollar Fair on 1968-11-01
source: This is a restoration/rework using shnid 18100 (Cotsman) and 09580 (Axelrod); Diamond Cut Forensics versions 8.5 and Alpha 9 for the editing.

ai_review.summary: A mixed recording – soundboard source with severe cuts and attenuated sections, yet it captures an otherwise awesome late‑1968 performance.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as “awesome” by a fan who loves the era’s material, though a key favorite (New Potato) is missing. The restored soundboard suffers from dramatic drop‑outs and hacked‑up segments, making parts of the jam hard to follow, but it does preserve extra minutes of the Alligator jam into Caution that are absent elsewhere.

ai_rating.rationale: Positive remarks about the musical performance (high show rating) offset by strong criticism of the recording’s technical flaws; weighted average yields a solid‑above‑average score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Attenuated signal in sections, dramatic cuts and hacked‑up audio make parts of the jam difficult to listen to; however, some unique extra minutes of the Alligator jam are present.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed set‑list comments; reviewers note the overall show was enjoyable despite missing New Potato.
